Insurance is a long-term business, which is why we at ERGO always have our sights set on the future. We operate responsibly, are committed to environmental and climate protection, create a good working environment for our employees and are committed to others. Join us in looking ahead and find out what ERGO is doing for sustainability.

Our content at a glance
ERGO advisory topics – find us here now
Our previous advisory section has moved. Practical everyday tips on digital topics, health, travel, home & living and financial provision can now be found in the ERGO advisory section at ergo.de (German only). Detailed background information and studies – for example on weather damage and extreme weather events – are available in our Reports & Dossiers as well as in further specialist articles here on ergo.com. Corporate news can be found in our Newsroom, and stories from within the company in the //radar magazine.

FAQ
Where can I find ERGO's advisory topics now?
I'm a customer – where can I now find tips on insurance, provision or health?
Practical advisory topics for everyday life are now bundled at
ergo.de
(available in German only)
– for example on
Health
,
Financial Provision
,
Home & Living
or
Travel & Leisure
.
I'm a journalist – where can I now find advisory topics for my reporting?
Studies, statistics and background reports on consumer topics – such as accident risks, health trends or weather damage – can be found in our
Reports & Dossiers
. Current corporate news and press contacts are available in the
Newsroom
.
Where can I now find information on climate impacts and weather events?
This topic was not carried over into the customer-facing advisory topics. Background and analysis remain available in our Reports & Dossiers, in the
section on extreme weather events
(German only)
.
Where can I now find topics on digitalisation and technology trends?
Practical tips on digital everyday life are available under
Digitalisation
among our advisory topics at ergo.de
(German only)
. Technology trends from a corporate perspective – such as the
Tech Trend Radar
– can be found in the
//radar Magazine
as well as our
Reports & Dossiers
.
Where can I now find topics on provision, incapacity to work or in the event of death?
These topics can now be found under
Financial Provision
,
Incapacity to Work
,
Long-term Care
and
In the Event of Death
among our advisory topics
(German only)
.
Why are the ERGO advisory topics no longer available on this page?
We have discontinued this section, as we already offer a comprehensive range of consumer content among our
advisory topics at ergo.de
(German only)
.
